sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Removes resurrection, wards, invincibility, damage reflection, continuous healing, and damage reduction effects.
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 300. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 120. Applies stun.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 50% of max CP.
-Target: all allies. Applies the following effect for 60 seconds: Recovers 5 Cost when using an Ability.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases Unison gauge gains by 3 for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000

[World's Best Hacker] Kurumi or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
